name: const unsafe fn into_inner_unchecked (pin : Pin < Ptr >) -> Ptr
rule: After calling `into_inner_unchecked`, the caller must ensure that the returned `Ptr` continues to be treated as pinned and that the data it points to remains subject to the pinning invariants until that data's drop handler has completed.
